items.label: designed-for-method
items.quote: WBS's direction is extracted from the benchmark's OWN directed_modulation items, which were CAREFULLY designed (by benchmark authors) to elicit a strong, clean "think about X while writing" state.
items.conclusion: Suspects benchmark items were curated so only WBS-style direction works well.

items.label: anomaly
items.quote: Wait, that was suspiciously fast (2.4s each), compared to the earlier scenes captures (~35s). Maybe the server caches, or these prompts are shorter

items.label: designed-for-method
items.quote: Therefore, a truly NOVEL direction CANNOT come from the benchmark's curated pairs (none others exist), and hand-written ones fail. So a genuinely novel DIRECTION that works may be IMPOSSIBLE within these constraints.
items.conclusion: Suspects the benchmark/task setup is structured so only the paper's WBS-style direction can succeed.
